Hey, I'm Cathryn 👋

Founder of BestSelf Co — bootstrapped to $55M+, sold to PE in 2022, bought it back in 2024.

The shift

I spent years hiring developers to build my ideas. Now I build them myself using Claude Code, Codex, and learning more every day.

What I've built

  • diagram-design — 42 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG, with imports from Mermaid, draw.io, and Excalidraw. No shadows. No Mermaid slop. Reached #1 on GitHub Trending in August 2026.

  • openclaw-ops — Operations skill: health checks, repair scripts, watchdogs, update triage, security scans.

  • codex-skill — Give Claude Code a second opinion using OpenAI Codex — automatic plan review via hooks.

  • voice-memo-organizer — Organizes hundreds of Apple Voice Memos into a searchable archive with transcriptions and summaries. No API keys needed.

  • repo-atlas — Builds a persistent context system for any git repo — fast LLM onboarding for agents.

  • agent-improvement-loop — Local session-mining loop for staging AI agent improvements and content ideas.

  • spend-optimizer — Audit subscriptions and optimize credit card rewards.

  • shopify-developer-skill — Shopify expertise for Claude Code — verifies current APIs before coding.

  • problem-solver-skill — Systematic problem diagnosis using progressive disclosure.

  • shiprank — Public leaderboard for developers who ship. Live at shiprank.dev.

Printed CLIs

I use CLI Printing Press to turn APIs into agent-native CLIs and MCP servers. These are my published prints in the public library:

  • AI: Context.dev, ElevenLabs, Mixlayer, TwelveLabs, WaveSpeed, xAI
  • Commerce: Amazon Ads, Amazon Seller, Facebook Marketplace, Shopify, TikTok Shop
  • Marketing: Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Judge.me, Judgeme, Kit, Klaviyo, SendFox
  • Cloud + monitoring: Cloud Run Admin, Cloudflare, Tailscale, Sentry
  • Productivity + auth: 1Password, BreezeDoc, Postmark, TidyCal
  • Media + social: Google Photos, Linq, X / Twitter
  • Payments + travel: Mercury, Seats.aero
  • Devices: Vestaboard

Loops is in review as the next public print.

Contributing to

  • openclaw/openclaw — Your own personal AI assistant. Fixed bypassPermissions on custom CLI args, auth token auto-generation during gateway install, launchd kickstart on supervised restart.
  • silverstein/minutes — Privacy-first conversation memory. Unified design system, Xcode build auto-recovery, screen share privacy fix.
  • paperclipai/paperclip — Open-source orchestration for zero-human companies.
  • mvanhorn/cli-printing-press — Contributor to the generator that turns APIs into agent-native CLIs and MCP servers.
  • mvanhorn/printing-press-library — Published the CLIs above and improved the public catalog.
  • openclaw/gogcli — Fixed positional Google Sheets updates so they stay inside the requested range.
  • EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin — Improved platform aggregator lookup in the brainstorming skill.
  • jeffreydebolt/Flowcoach2 and jeffreydebolt/fifo-inventory-system — Added architecture reference documentation.

Writing

I write Little Might — for operators getting technical, and builders learning to operate. I go deep on one hard thing at a time, then write down exactly how to do it yourself.

Zehua Zeng

AI x Bioinformatics Researcher building open-source tools for multi-omics, single-cell, spatial biology, and reproducible computational workflows.

About Me

  • I work at the intersection of AI, bioinformatics, and translational medicine.
  • My core interests are multi-omics integration, single-cell analysis, spatial biology, and cancer-related applications.
  • I build research software, tutorials, and reproducible analysis pipelines for real scientific workflows.
  • I am currently working across 112 Lab, Qiu Lab, University of Science and Technology Beijing, and the Department of Genetics at Stanford University.
  • I am open to collaboration on computational biology methods, open-source infrastructure, and research-driven product building.

Current focus

  • Single-cell and spatial omics tooling
  • Multi-omics integration workflows
  • Reproducible computational biology
  • Open-source platforms for research labs
